apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Apps to scrape: App Store URLs (https://apps.shopify.com/judgeme) or handles (judgeme).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: App Store categories to scrape every app from, as URLs (https://apps.shopify.com/categories/marketing-and-conversion-social-trust-product-reviews/all) or slugs. A parent category such as marketing-and-conversion is expanded into all its subcategories.

allApps.title: All apps
allApps.description: Scrape the whole catalog from the App Store sitemap (about 30,000 apps). Set Max apps to 0 to take all of them.

maxApps.title: Max apps
maxApps.description: Maximum number of apps in the run, from all sources together. 0 means no limit.

includeReviews.title: Include reviews
includeReviews.description: Scrape merchant reviews of every app, newest first.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Maximum number of reviews for each app. 0 means all reviews (popular apps have tens of thousands).

reviewsSince.title: Reviews since
reviewsSince.description: Only reviews posted or edited on this day or later, e.g. 2026-01-31. Leave empty for all. Useful for scheduled monitoring.

minRating.title: Min review rating
minRating.description: Only reviews with at least this many stars (1-5).

maxRating.title: Max review rating
maxRating.description: Only reviews with at most this many stars (1-5). Set both to 1 and 2 to collect complaints only.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers to use. The Shopify App Store works without a proxy. Plan prices are shown in the currency of the proxy's country.
